_comment: LIVE fixture — the registry (native/dev) facet of the six services the SAFE serve fixture admits. Each row's projectSlug:role is the canonical serviceId `bosun serve` keys /state by (gallery:frontend, gallery:api, atlas:frontend, ledger:api, minard:frontend, archive:api). projectName == the compose service name and the startCommand cwd basename == the compose build-context basename, so reconcile bridges the two facets by directory basename (Bosun.Reconcile.buildAliases) and the merged graph node correlates to /state. Ports mirror fixtures/serve/registry.json. Analyze-only — never spawned.
